create_WaferPreprocessor: create a WaferPreprocessor instance with config and tensorizer to preprocess queries and passages into token tensors
build_preprocess_query: build a token tensor from a query string split by [SEP] and [CIT] delimiters with configurable field composition
build_preprocess_passage: build a token tensor from a WaferPassage with title and text fields normalized and padded to max length
create_WaferPassage: create a WaferPassage namedtuple with text, title, url, passage_id, bm25_hit, and rank fields
create_passage_struct_from_dict: create a WaferPassage struct from a dictionary with text, title, url, and optional passage_id fields
